facts.fact: Executive Order No. 163, signed 22 April 2026, creates the Office of Technology, Digitalization and Innovation (OTDI) and introduces a Government Enterprise Architecture Framework and a Government Interoperability Framework, with OTDI to present a prioritized roadmap within 180 days; the report describes no adopted framework text.

note: A sector-only (education) EMIS modernisation roadmap with learner and teacher IDs; not a government-wide interoperability framework.
